import pathlib,json,re,os
out=pathlib.Path(os.environ['OUT']); selected=[]
for line in pathlib.Path('store/jobs/j000309/out/deterministic-key-contexts-ascii.jsonl').open():
 r=json.loads(line)
 for m in re.finditer(r'[\x20-\x7e\t\r\n]{100,}',r['context']):
  if 'getDeterministicKey' in m.group():
   selected.append({'start':r['context_start']+m.start(),'end':r['context_start']+m.end(),'source':m.group()})
(out/'getter-static-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(selected,indent=2))
print(json.dumps({'runs':len(selected),'ranges':[[r['start'],r['end']] for r in selected]}))
PY
